title: Yyz's backpacks Rebackpacked
description: A small leather and iron backpack you can craft, and many more to find while exploring. You can access your backpacks from your normal inventory.
body:
A small leather and iron backpack you can craft, and many more to find while exploring. You can access your backpacks from your normal inventory, and it's awesome.

This is a fork of https://modrinth.com/mod/yyzs-backpack

List of changes:
-Renamed all backpacks. (iron --> small backpack, gold --> nether backpack, diamond --> end backpack, netherite --> depths backpack)
-Made it so only the iron backpack is craftable, and the other ones have to be found while exploring.
-Nerfed the capacity of all backpacks. 54 slots is... way way too much
